source.note: Wave 29 W29-4.1: the Visual Reports - Create Report and Compare Project Versions dialogs, opened in Project Professional 2021 (16.0.20430.20182) through UI Automation on the Report tab's own ribbon buttons, from a read-only working copy of tests/data/synthetic-base.mpp. The captures (screenshots, window geometry and the control/content probe) stay local under build/w29/; only the numbers and UI strings below are committed. Rect form: [x, y, width, height], client-relative. The Compare Projects group title embeds the opened copy's file name, so group_text is the pattern with %1 in place of the name. The Visual Reports tab control is one captured control whose seven owner-drawn items are drawn on two visible rows; tabs.rows records the visible layout and tabs.labels the control's item order. The three combo boxes are owner-drawn: CB_GETLBTEXT returns CB_ERR, so only the captured item count, current index and visible text are recorded, not the unseen item strings.
